headline: Approved the August minutes; discussed AI panel, art auction, and annual meeting plans.
summary: Library Director Jenny Benedict gave an update on recent and upcoming programs. Plans for an AI panel, an art auction, and the annual meeting were discussed.
decisions: Approved the August 11, 2026 minutes as presented.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of Minutes from August 11, 2026. The minutes were approved as presented.

plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
Gloucester Lyceum & Sawyer Free Library 
Corporate Communications Committee  
Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 9:00 AM 
As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, this Committee will continue to hold meetings 
remotely. Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below. 
Via Zoom only: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86018488672  
To join by phone:  646-931-3860  
 
Attendance: Fran Aliberte (Chair), Christine Araujo, Jason Brisbois, Cheryl Marks, Dawn Sarrouf, 
Library Director Jenny Benedict, and guests Geoff Bradford (joined at 9:15, left at 9:57), and Julia 
Brotherton 
 
Not Present: n/a 
 
1. Call to order  
 
2. Welcome + Introductions 
 
3. Approval of Minutes from August 11, 2026. The minutes were approved as presented.  
 
4. Library Programming Update - Jenny 
a. Jenny shared an update on recent programs including a local history story-
sharing, film screenings, Teen Room art project unveiling, Countdown to 
Kindergarten, 5th grade visits, and more. 
b. Upcoming (just some of the programs and events):  
i. Adult: Sound Artist in Residency kick off on September 24, followed with 
weekly workshops and a demonstration on October 29; Second Tech on 
the Horizon program with Chris Spittle from Cape Ann Weather on 
October 15; Tech Expo: a day of digital discovery; Partnership with 
Manship: Two film screenings about David Hockney.   
ii. Local History:  Rockaway Hotel on October 16th, local author talks. 
iii. Children: Backyard Growers weekly Harvest Storytime; Babies, Books, and 
Bubbles; Board Game Bonanza;  
iv. Teens: Dungeons and Dragons; Ghost Paintings; Painting Journals.  
 
5. Lyceum Press Release 
a. AI Panel: Promise and Peril: A Conversation 
i. Jon Keller will moderate. The three panelists are: Roopika Risam, Nir 
Eisikovits, Hilary Robinson.    
1. The working group is arranging contracts. 
ii. Christine Armstrong is working with Julia on marketing. 
iii. The event will be held at City Hall. Studio 1623 will film it. 
iv. They've applied for a grant from Inst. for Savings to cover expenses. 
b. The Committee reviewed the press release. Julia will incorporate suggestions.
Page 2 of 2 
 
6. Art Auction Update - Fran/Geoff 
a. Both the live and the silent auction will happen on the main floor.  
b. We have enough sponsors to cover most of the costs.  
c. Christine Armstrong is looking for greeters and runners to help at the auction. 
 
7. Annual Meeting - Fran 
a. Date: TBD. The date per the bylaws would fall on Veteran's Day. The Board will 
vote on an alternate date. 
b. Theme: Freedom to Know: Libraries, Intellectual Freedom, and the Future of an 
Informed Community. 
c. Speaker: Do we want to have a speaker? 
d. Annual Report: This will include an update from the FY2026 audit. Christine 
Armstrong will create a schedule for when items are due for inclusion in the 
report. 
e. Corporators: New Corporators will be voted in. 
 
8. Development Committee - Geoff 
a. We would like to create a group of volunteers to support Christine Armstrong in 
her work - thank yous, etc.  
b. There was discussion on ideal make-up of the group.  
c. Timing: Be ready to launch this at the Annual Meeting.  
d. We are interested in hiring a part-time grant writer to help with applications to 
family foundations.  
 
9. Next meeting: Tuesday October 13, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. – 10:00 a.m. 
 
10. 10:00 Adjourn. There being no further business the meeting was adjourned. 
 
Respectfully submitted, Tracy Bowen
